name: Logos
overview: The concept of Logos, or the Word, reveals the eternal and divine nature of Christ, who was with God in the beginning and is Himself God, as John 1:1 declares. This Word is not merely a spoken command, as seen in Genesis 1:3 where God speaks light into existence, but is incarnate, becoming flesh and dwelling among humanity to reveal God's glory (John 1:14). Christ, the living bread from heaven (John 6:51), embodies the fullness of grace and truth, and as the image of the invisible God (Colossians 1:15), He uniquely reveals the Father to the world.
